profile_text.body:
Salesforce is a public company founded in 1999 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, traded under the ticker CRM with CIK 0001108524. The material harvested from its site is Slack's AI features page, where the company describes AI in Slack as a way to summarize channels and threads, search files, take meeting notes, translate conversations, and build automations. Slackbot is described as a personal AI agent inside Slack that understands a user and their workspace, helps prepare for meetings, analyze reports, and create project briefs, and adapts to the user's tone and style.

The company's tracked AI products are Slack AI, Tableau AI (Einstein), and Salesforce Einstein / Agentforce. Slack describes itself as the conversational UI for Agentforce, with agents built in Agentforce running directly in Slack channels, threads, and direct messages so users can query data, get contextual responses, and trigger actions. The company states that customer data is not used to train large language models and that LLM providers do not have access to customer data, with the models hosted inside Slack's AWS virtual private cloud. It also states that AI features are available across all paid Slack plans.

Additional held facts: six MCP servers are listed, including ai.cirra/salesforce-mcp for administration and management, several ai.smithery/kodey-ai-salesforce-mcp variants for running SOQL queries against a Salesforce org, and cloud.serpent/salesforce-devops for planning deploys, opening pull requests, and triggering pipelines from an AI client. The most recent revenue filing is a 10-K for the period ending 2026-01-31, reporting $41,525,000,000. Litigation exposure is recorded in California with a count of 281.
